Photographs and video of the moment quickly spread around the world, sparking widespread criticism and concern about the child’s safety.

Soon afterward, Jackson released a public apology, saying he had made “a terrible mistake” and that he had been caught up in the excitement of the moment.

Although no injury occurred, the incident became one of the most infamous moments of Jackson’s later career and was frequently referenced in media coverage about his life in the years that followed.

snippet.title: Michael Jackson's Daughter Paris Jackson Details Meeting Her Mom at 15 | E! News
snippet.description:
Paris Jackson—who was primarily raised by her dad Michael Jackson until his 2009 death—detailed the moment she met her mom Debbie Rowe for the first time when she was 15 years old. During an Aug. 12 appearance on Call Her Daddy, the 28-year-old recalled the surprisingly casual encounter, sharing that she simply greeted Debbie with, “Hey, mom,” before the two spent the day together. Paris said she called Rowe “mom” right away and revealed they bonded over their similarities, including both being fire signs—Paris an Aries and Rowe a Sagittarius. The 67-year-old is also the biological mother of Paris’ older brother Prince Jackson, 29. Michael is also dad to son Bigi Jackson, 24, who was born via surrogate. Paris, Prince and Bigi were primarily raised by the King of Pop before his death in 2009 at age 50, with Paris later reconnecting with Debbie as a teenager and developing a closer relationship with her over the years.
